title: Money Mastery
tagline: Read a paycheck, budget, build credit, dodge scams and start investing.
description: Learn to read your paycheck, stop worrying about taxes, and set up a budget, a bank account and an emergency fund that actually work. Build credit safely, use a credit card without falling into debt, spot scams and bad loans, and start investing the simple way.

title: Adulting 101
tagline: Rent, insurance, doctors, cars, cooking and paperwork, handled.
description: The practical skills nobody hands you a manual for: renting your first place, choosing insurance, getting the right medical care, and keeping a car running. You will also learn the home fixes that save a service call, how to eat well on a budget without getting sick, and how to keep your important documents safe.

title: Career Launch
tagline: Land the job, nail the interview, get paid what you're worth.
description: Go from no experience to a job offer: find openings, write a resume that shows results, and answer interview questions with clear stories. Then learn the habits that get you trusted at work, how to negotiate pay, how side income is taxed, and how to compare college, trades and certificates by what they really return.

title: Body and Health
tagline: Sleep, eat, move, and know what to do when things go wrong.
description: Build the everyday habits that keep you healthy: enough sleep, food that fuels you, a simple strength and cardio routine, and regular checkups. Then learn how to handle stress, when and how to get help for your mental health, and the first aid basics for emergencies. The first aid lessons are an introduction, not a replacement for a certified class.

title: Learn How to Learn
tagline: Study less, remember more: the science of learning that sticks.
description: Swap rereading and cramming for the techniques memory research rates highest: self-testing, spacing and mixing. You will build your own review schedule, protect your focus, use memory tricks that work, and get good at any new skill faster.

title: Think Clearly
tagline: Catch your brain's shortcuts, spot bad info, and make better calls.
description: Learn the mental shortcuts that trip up smart people, how to take apart a bad argument, how to check a claim (or an AI fake) in under a minute, the few numbers ideas that protect you from scary headlines and bad deals, and simple tools for making big decisions.
unitTitles: Spot Bad Arguments and Bad Info

title: People Skills
tagline: Listen well, handle conflict, negotiate, speak up and keep friends.
description: Practical, research-backed skills for dealing with people: real listening, easy conversations, feedback that helps, calm conflict, good apologies, fair negotiation, confident public speaking, and making and keeping friends. Every level includes scripts you can actually say.

title: Self-Mastery
tagline: Build habits, beat procrastination, and handle stress and setbacks.
description: The science of getting yourself to do what you said you would: habits that run on autopilot, beating procrastination, planning your week, setting goals that work, taming your phone, managing emotions, bouncing back from failure, and reviewing your life so you keep improving.

title: Gospel Foundations
tagline: Know and explain the core doctrines missionaries teach.
description: Learn the missionary purpose and the doctrines in the lessons of Preach My Gospel chapter 3: the Restoration, the plan of salvation, the gospel of Jesus Christ and lifelong discipleship. You will match key scriptures to doctrines and practise explaining each truth simply and kindly in your own words.

title: Scripture and Testimony
tagline: Study like a missionary, know key verses, and feel the Spirit.
description: Build the daily study habits missionaries live by, from a study journal to Come, Follow Me. Learn the Doctrinal Mastery passages and how to answer hard questions in faith. Practise recognizing the Spirit, strengthen your testimony and write a first draft of it in your own words.

title: Missionary Life Skills
tagline: Get ready, live the schedule, stay healthy, safe and resilient.
description: Walk through getting ready to serve: worthiness, the recommendation, health, saving and packing. Then practise the everyday skills of missionary life: the daily schedule, P-day chores, cooking, budgeting your monthly funds, working with a companion, handling stress, staying fit and following Missionary Standards. Policies can change, so each lesson points you to the official page and your bishop.

title: Teaching People Like Christ
tagline: Find, listen, teach by the Spirit and invite with love.
description: Practise the people skills at the heart of Preach My Gospel: developing Christlike attributes, learning a language, talking with strangers, asking inspired questions and listening. Then learn to teach by the Spirit, extend clear invitations, help with concerns, handle rejection and work with members and leaders.
